name: Financial Assistance to dependents in Case of Death of Registered Workers(JKBOCWWB)
benefit: A financial assistance of ₹2,00,000/- is provided.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a dependent of the deceased worker.
   1. The deceased should have been registered with the &quot;Jammu and Kashmir Building &amp; Other Construction Workers Welfare Board&quot;.
   1. The deceased should have held an active membership with the Board.
   1. The scheme can be applied only once.
